detailed_descriptions.en: You're a brokie ended up losing your job because of the local mafia. No other jobs are available and your parents are not alive to help you. Find ways to get your bread to survive the urban jungle. Contend against intensifying law enforcement and deadly mafia syndicates to expand your income sources, pay the bills and feed your homies and yourself. Explore and survive the urban jungle of Brokhattan,NY. - Prepare yourself for heists and missions against rival gang members alone or with friends! Take back what belongs to you and take control of the street ruft, use the money stolen to invest back into better equipment or even buy real estate! Produce your own stuff at home! Wire printers, grow plants, manage inventory, and redistribute product for more profit and automate your passive income! Commit different types of crimes. Extort, mug, hijack or breach into people's apartments to get some loot or valuable items to then resell for profit. But be careful as cops might be searching for you or the rival gang might get the rumors in a bad light. Lots customization and stuff to spend your money on! Or, goof around with friends! (My favorite part)
